spec.name: unsupported-claims-removed
spec.intent: Remove every documentation and packaging claim that cratylus supports a harness other than Claude Code and omp, and every description of those two that is false at this commit (loci from the supported-harness assay, agent://AssaySupportedHarness/uncovered). DELETE docs/release-audit-checklist.md, docs/research/harness-reach-matrix.md and docs/claude-agents-md-assumption.md (stale contract/research sheets describing adapters, an IR and a tripwire that no longer exist; git keeps the history), and fix every link to them. packages/cli/package.json and docs/cli/USAGE.md say 'any harness': say Claude Code and omp. Drop USAGE's argument that the closed registry is a defect and its call for third-party adapters. packages/forge/README.md: deploy and project are per-harness (--harness claude|omp), settings.json is claude's, omp emits enforcing modules; its option table gains --harness. packages/cli/README.md states the real differences a user meets: claude realizes 19 of 31 lifecycle events natively and omp 9; event-tap works on Claude Code only; the persona badge and launcher, and role routing via modelRoles, are omp's. forge core/harness-adapter.ts drops the Cursor reach claim; the omp adapter headers stop calling omp 'the third harness'. Remove @iarna/toml from packages/forge/package.json and its pnpm-workspace.yaml catalog entry, and refresh the lockfile. Do NOT edit VISION.md (ground; surfaced to the operator).
accept: the three stale docs are gone and git grep for their filenames outside records/ and CHANGELOGs prints nothing

git grep -n -i -E 'aider|cline|continue\.dev|copilot|crush|cursor|gemini|opencode|goose|antigravity|kilo|devin|\bzed\b|any harness|third harness' -- docs packages ':!**/CHANGELOG.md' ':!records' prints nothing, or only lines the implementer justifies as not a support claim
packages/forge/README.md documents --harness for deploy and project and no longer says deploy targets .claude only
packages/cli/README.md states the 19-of-31 vs 9-of-31 event reach and that event-tap is Claude Code only
git grep iarna -- packages pnpm-workspace.yaml prints nothing and pnpm install --frozen-lockfile succeeds
prettier --check on changed markdown and biome check on changed code pass
